current_state_2026_05_27: D3D11 FULLY WORKING + now the Windows default. Renders text/bg/multi-line, input types+echoes+executes (no doubling), cursor block, 60fps continuous. THE freeze bug: D3D11 Frame.complete was a no-op → never released the SwapChain frame semaphore (swap_chain_count=3) → nextFrame() blocked forever after 3 frames → whole renderer thread froze. Fix: Frame.complete calls self.renderer.frameCompleted(.healthy). Also: win32 manual render loop in renderer/Thread.zig (run(.no_wait)+drainMailbox+updateFrame+drawFrame+sleep) replaces the blocking loop.run(.until_done) which wedges on Windows IOCP. Local echo REMOVED (cmd echoes + renders fine now, local echo only doubled). backend.zig default flipped to .d3d11 for windows.

tasks.title: D3D11: real Buffer impl
directions: Implement `Buffer(T).init(opts, len)`: CreateBuffer with `D3D11_BUFFER_DESC{ ByteWidth = len * @sizeOf(T), Usage = DYNAMIC, BindFlags = opts.bind_flags, CPUAccessFlags = WRITE }`. Store `*ID3D11Buffer` + len + opts.
Implement `initFill(opts, data)`: same as init but with `pInitialData = &D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA{ pSysMem = data.ptr }` and Usage = IMMUTABLE.
Implement `sync(data)`: Map(D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0) → memcpy → Unmap. Grow buffer if data.len > capacity (release + recreate larger).
Implement `syncFromArrayLists(lists)`: total len = sum of list lens; Map; for each list memcpy in sequence; Unmap. Return total instance count.
Implement `deinit()`: Release the ID3D11Buffer.

Pattern reference: `src/renderer/opengl/buffer.zig` is the structural mirror; for the D3D11 Map/Unmap call sequence, see `src/apprt/win32/d3d11.zig::buildTrianglePipeline` end (it does CreateBuffer with initial data).
API gap: `ID3D11DeviceContext::Map` and `Unmap` are NOT yet typed in src/renderer/d3d11/api.zig — add them (they sit between PSSetShader and PSSetConstantBuffers in the vtable, see d3d11.h).
VALIDATE: with d3d11 default, the engine startup populates uniform + cell buffers; you should see no `D3D11NotYetImplemented` log spam from drawFrame.

tasks.title: D3D11: real Texture impl
directions: Implement `init(opts, w, h, data)`: CreateTexture2D with `D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC{ Width, Height, MipLevels = 1, ArraySize = 1, Format = opts.pixel_format, SampleDesc = {1,0}, Usage = DEFAULT, BindFlags = SHADER_RESOURCE, CPUAccessFlags = {} }` and optional initial data via D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA{ pSysMem = data, SysMemPitch = w * bpp }.
After CreateTexture2D, CreateShaderResourceView with NULL desc (uses texture's format).
Compute bpp from format: R8_UNORM=1, R8G8B8A8_UNORM=4, B8G8R8A8_UNORM=4.
Implement `replaceRegion(x, y, w, h, data)`: UpdateSubresource(tex, 0, &D3D11_BOX{ left=x, top=y, right=x+w, bottom=y+h, front=0, back=1 }, data.ptr, w * bpp, 0).
Implement `deinit()`: Release SRV then texture.

API gap: D3D11_BOX + UpdateSubresource + CreateShaderResourceView are not yet typed in api.zig — add the vtable entries on ID3D11Device (CreateShaderResourceView already at slot 8 as anyopaque, just type it) and on ID3D11DeviceContext (UpdateSubresource).

tasks.title: D3D11: HLSL shaders + Pipelines
directions: Port 5 shaders from src/renderer/shaders/glsl/ to HLSL: bg_color, cell_bg, cell_text, image, bg_image. Embed via @embedFile or compile from a shaders subdirectory.

GLSL → HLSL syntax mapping: `vec4` → `float4`, `mat4` → `float4x4`, layout(binding=N) uniform → cbuffer with register(bN), layout(location=N) in/out → semantic POSITION/COLOR/etc., `texture(sampler, uv)` → `tex.Sample(samp, uv)`. Set SV_POSITION as gl_Position equivalent.

Uniforms cbuffer layout MUST exactly match `shaders.Uniforms` extern struct (already ported from metal). HLSL constant buffers have 16-byte alignment rules — same as Metal/Zig extern with align(16); should match directly.
For each shader: D3DCompile (vs_5_0 / ps_5_0) the source → get VS bytecode + PS bytecode → CreateVertexShader + CreatePixelShader + CreateInputLayout (with the bytecode for signature validation).
Build a Pipeline struct holding {vs, ps, input_layout, blend_state, raster_state}. Pre-create per-shader blend states (cell_text needs alpha blending; bg_color is opaque).
Call `d3d.loadD3DCompiler()` once in Shaders.init before any D3DCompile call.
VALIDATE: 5 pipelines compile without HLSL errors (D3DCompile error blobs are logged via `err_blob.bufferPointer`); engine startup gets past initShaders.

tasks.title: D3D11: Frame + RenderPass real impl
directions: Frame.begin(opts, renderer, target): store device context ref + the offscreen target. No-op-ish — just bookkeeping.
Frame.complete(sync): no work needed beyond the swap-chain Present already in drawFrameEnd.
Frame.renderPass(attachments): construct a RenderPass that holds the target's RTV + clear color.
RenderPass.begin: OMSetRenderTargets(rtv) + ClearRenderTargetView (if clear_color set) + RSSetViewports.

RenderPass.step(step): for each step, IASetInputLayout, VSSetShader, PSSetShader, IASetVertexBuffers (step.buffers), VSSetConstantBuffers(step.uniforms), PSSetShaderResources(step.textures), DrawInstanced or Draw based on step.draw.
RenderPass.complete: no-op (state machine resets on next pass).
Generic.zig pass.step is called with a struct literal `.{ .pipeline, .uniforms, .buffers, .textures, .draw }` — accept anytype and unpack at compile-time.
VALIDATE: a full text frame draws — typed characters appear via D3D11 cell_text shader.

tasks.title: D3D11: Target offscreen FBO equivalent
directions: Target.init(opts): CreateTexture2D with RENDER_TARGET + SHADER_RESOURCE bind flags. Create RTV + SRV.
Target.deinit: release SRV, RTV, texture.
The renderer renders into Target's RTV, then `present(target)` blits Target → swap chain back buffer. This mirrors OpenGL's FBO → default-FB BlitFramebuffer.
VALIDATE: resize works (target gets recreated, viewport updates, no stretching).

known_traps: Cache wipe: a clean .zig-cache forces a fresh build that exposed 2 latent issues: WinMain unresolved (subsystem=Console fixed it) and d3dcompiler_47.lib missing (runtime LoadLibrary fixed it). Don't be alarmed if these resurface after another wipe — re-read Session 7 of the project memory.
Cross-drive panic: ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR MUST be on the same drive as the build root. Setting it on C: while building from E: triggers `std.fs.path.relative` assert.
Zig 0.15 pointless-discard: `_ = surface;` in a switch arm becomes a compile error if ANOTHER arm uses `surface`. Cross-arm analysis. Solution: drop discards of function params entirely.
*const D3D11 in threadEnter: can't mutate the struct directly; use the heap-allocated SwapState pointer for any per-surface mutable state.

SetPixelFormat on HWND can only happen once. If you attach a DXGI swap chain to an HWND, a subsequent WGL SetPixelFormat will silently fail (visible as: triangle persists, GL draws nothing). The apprt-side D3D11 proof-of-life was removed for exactly this reason.

ParentWindow + Surface have a back-pointer wiring order: Surface.create must set `window.surface = self` BEFORE calling core_surface.init, because the initial resize callback fires during init and dereferences that pointer.
